workflows.name: Promote Release Candidate
workflows.description: Promotes a validated release candidate build to the production channel and updates deployment manifests across affected services.

preconditions: Release candidate has passed the full CI gate
No open Sev-1/Sev-2 incidents on affected services
Changelog has been generated for the release

required.name: release_tag
required.desc: Git tag of the validated release candidate

workflows.name: Provision Repository Access
workflows.description: Grants a scoped, time-bounded write access role to a requested repository after ownership confirms the request.

preconditions: Requester has an active engineering identity

workflows.name: Archive Deprecated Repository
workflows.description: Archives a repository flagged as deprecated: disables writes, snapshots CI config, and notifies remaining contributors.

preconditions: Repository has had zero commits in 180 days
No active deployment depends on the repository

workflows.name: Publish API Documentation
workflows.description: Builds and publishes the latest API reference documentation from source annotations to the public docs site.

required.name: source_ref
required.desc: Commit or tag to build from

workflows.name: Deprecate Public API Endpoint
workflows.description: Marks a public API endpoint as deprecated, updates documentation with a sunset date, and notifies registered API consumers.

preconditions: Sunset date is at least 90 days out

required.name: sunset_date
required.desc: Date the endpoint stops serving traffic

workflows.name: Rotate Service Credentials
workflows.description: Rotates a service's production credentials, updates the secret store, and performs a staged restart of dependent services.

workflows.name: Close Stale Sprint Issues
workflows.description: Identifies issues untouched for the configured window within a sprint board and closes them with an explanatory comment.

workflows.name: Generate Sprint Retrospective Report
workflows.description: Compiles velocity, carry-over, and incident data for the closed sprint into a structured retrospective report.

workflows.name: Escalate Critical Bug
workflows.description: Escalates a critical bug to the owning team's on-call, opens an incident channel, and applies the escalation label.

workflows.name: Request Production Database Access
workflows.description: Requests temporary, audited read access to a production database for incident investigation or migration support.

workflows.name: Broadcast Incident Notification
workflows.description: Sends a structured incident notification to affected team channels and the status page subscriber list.

workflows.name: Sync On-call Schedule
workflows.description: Synchronizes the on-call rotation from the scheduling source of truth into paging and chat integrations.
